cases.title: Edit Pipe on P3 with new levels updates 4 pipes and 3 pits downstream, one U takes it all back, REDO puts it back
cases.plan_item: Edit Pipe cascade with U and REDO (gap plan section 3 item 7; regression C40; UX-LBL-02)
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 24 Oct 2026 with card C40 (TEST_CASES_DRAFT_22OCT.md, spec 5.10 C40) and robot run 47 B.4.5: same route and the same expected lines. Differences: Save is pressed as the button named Edit pipe, Save (renamed on 3.0.72); the new pit P8 is not added; the invert texts are compared as one whole set (before, after the cascade, after U, after REDO), not per pipe, which closes the card's open point that U must restore the old levels.
cases.expected: Select pipe P3 (10A98D), CDEDIT, answer Y to the older-version question, set the first invert 17.60 and the second 17.50, press Edit pipe, Save (id C2.OkCommand); the box 'Recalculate downstream inverts' answered Yes opens the Cascade Preview; Apply says '[CDEDIT-CASCADE] Updated 4 pipes and 3 pits from P3 (IL 17.50). Min grade: 1:16.'; the invert texts in the drawing change; one U echoes CDEDIT and every invert text reads as before the edit; after a 12 second wait REDO says 'Everything has been redone' and the invert texts read as after the cascade.
cases.why_not_unit: The real Edit Pipe window, the downstream recalculation, the invert texts, the project data and AutoCAD's undo stack all take part; only a live drawing shows that one U undoes the whole cascade and that REDO is still available.
not_automated: Which text belongs to which pipe is not mapped: the case compares the whole set of 'IL ' texts (handle and wording, in drawing order) as one string, not one pipe's text. Project data (the stored invert values) is not read.
The 'Updated 4 pipes and 3 pits' numbers come from run 47 on the drawing with the new pit P8 added; this case runs without P8. A different count is reported as a FAIL for a person to judge.
